title: Ghamgeen Hai Jahaan Shahadat Naqi ki Hain
body:
Ghamgeen hai jahan shahadat naqi ki hai.
<<MINI>>
Halat bhi gham se ghair hasan askeri ki hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Teghe jafa ka war ye zeher e dagha ka war.
Moula Ali ki hai ya shahadat Wasi ki hai.
<<MINI>>
Haalat bhi gham se ghair hasan askeri ki hai.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghamgeen.....
2.Daswe imam e paak pa moutizz ne ki jafa.
Zeher dagha jo deti hai ummat nabi ki hai.
<<MINI>>
Halat bhi gham se ghair hasan askeri ki hai.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghamgeen.....
3.Duniya se jaarahe hain naqi wa mohammeda.
Ye raat bekasi ki hai nouhagari ki hai.
<<MINI>>
Haalat bhi gham se ghair hasan askeri ki hai.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghamgeen hai jahaan shahadat naqi ki hain
Azz:-dawar Ali dawar
